title: kith-events: coalesce multi-type state changes into single SSE frame
description: RFC 8620 §7.1 requires a single StateChange push object to carry all changed types: {"changed":{"a-self":{"Message":"s-43","Chat":"s-12"}}}. Current implementation emits one SSE frame per StateChange broadcast. Fix requires broadcasting HashMap<type_name, new_state> instead of one StateChange struct per type, and coalescing within a scheduler tick before emitting. Deferred from kith-events Phase 1; needed before a real JMAP client library can be used.
